method: Read all451 individual owner, implementation-duty and ordered-step propositions, all101 full context profiles and35 caption occurrence sets. Every full payload is compared with immutable predecessor evidence; all2009 old occurrence bindings are transported exactly. Fixed ownership/structure/exposure/order is distinguished from current full contract/semantic/acceptance duties. Referenced application/test/proof files are not opened.

decisions.EXACT_OWNER_OR_SEQUENCE_CONTEXT: The exact caption, its immediate child IDs/ranges and supporting upstream or preceding-step context remain. It supplies an owner, mandatory duty category or sequence, not a claim that every child is unchanged. Added clauses are not absorbed into any original occurrence range.
decisions.PRESERVED_OWNERSHIP: This exact responsibility-to-final-owner assignment is unchanged. A preserves proposal/application/human ownership; C/C1 preserves byte custody; D keeps runtime/worker authority; F1 preserves original writers and F2 changes no executor. A changed value, registry or complete implementation duty does not reassign its final owner.
decisions.PRESERVED_ARCHITECTURE: The individual singular authority, static producer, dependency order, declarative worker, hard-limit/timeout, no-network/no-dynamic-code, context isolation or module-creation constraint is unchanged. D changes semantics within that boundary; C1 intake accounting does not replace native runtime limits.
decisions.PRESERVED_FILE_TRANSPORT: The exact file-first, named-slot, byte-custody, manifest membership, hash/parse/rehash/stage, retrieval/recovery and no-paste mechanisms remain. C1 expressly leaves external response transport separate from intake recursion; F2 support cannot imply automatic transfer or observed external custody. The broad current /3 support exception is separately corrected.
decisions.PRESERVED_UI: The individual structural facility, visual baseline/dimension, safe text/URL rendering, authority separation, no needless reselection/resupply, fixed wording, lifecycle distinction and canonical-change certainty remains. Current ready/blocker/proposal content cases are adjudicated separately; an unchanged UI mechanism does not inherit old acceptance proof.
decisions.PRESERVED_CLOSURE: The exact byte/build pin, serialization/ID/Unicode rule, explicit DAG identity, release precedence, independence/contradiction relation, transaction/retry/invalidation, delivery authority, candidate membership, backup/tombstone/recovery and source/runtime separation predicate remains. Complete current semantic domains and favorable prerequisites are changed separately.
decisions.PRESERVED_ORDER: The named implementation phase and predecessor-step ordering are unchanged. The individual retained step concerns the examined structural, authority, isolation, custody, transport, visual, history, identity or authorization property. This does not assert the step has been implemented or proved; full current-domain steps change separately.
decisions.CURRENT_NATIVE_CONTRACT: D now fixes exact native definitions, primitive arguments, ports/parser/selector grammar, normalized outputs and failure classes. B availability and E frozen normalized variance bind applicable current tests. These complete semantic implementation/registry/capability duties therefore require fresh effective context, preserving module ownership and order. Conditional XML subnode details remain explicit.
decisions.RAW_ACCOUNTING_IMPLEMENTATION: The actual Stage01 accounting/inventory metadata now implements C/C1 exact bytes, additive physical/structural/span units, distinct occurrences, authorized ZIP mapping, counters and typed blockers; A applies to invoked human fallback. Unknown remaining content is not zero and accounting is not semantic reading.
decisions.OBLIGATION_ACCOUNTING_COMPLETENESS: Complete current Stage04 obligation accounting consumes A/F2 admitted current external research/dispositions and existing independent review. Every obligation and valid disposition remains traceable; rejected/missing inputs cannot shrink the population.
decisions.COMPLETE_REGISTRIES_AND_MIGRATION: The full registry, durable-object, enum, migration and metadata import/export duty now covers the newly closed A/B/C/C1/D/E/F1/F2 contracts. /3 name equality is not conformance. Explicit complete current provenance or historical nongating preservation remains required; no missing normative reference is supplied by code.
decisions.ROUTING_DUE_AND_RELATION_DERIVATION: Current routing and due/relation calculations combine B TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN availability, D native support and F1 compatible accepted conditional route/history/phase with F2 minima. Future obligations remain visible; UNKNOWN cannot erase potentially due cells or authorize another executor.
decisions.EXACT_CURRENT_HANDOFF: Actual selected current handoff includes C/C1 supplied occurrence/member identity and applicable A human context, F1 current target bindings and F2 exact input support. Original exact-byte membership, engine authority and isolation remain; echoes do not prove semantic inspection or external observed custody.
decisions.CURRENT_INTAKE_AND_RESEARCH_CONSUMPTION: These complete current intake/persistence/reload/validation/replay duties consume A valid fallback context, C/C1 complete accounting/inspection lineage and F2 admitted external input. Stage01 remains first semantic reader with exhaustive passes; no repeated human resupply or invented pre-agent meaning follows.
decisions.CURRENT_RESEARCH_INPUT: Complete current Stage03 research inputs must satisfy A response admission and F2 required exact input support with the original source/review completeness. A stored reference or echo alone is not accepted semantic research; order remains.
decisions.CURRENT_EVIDENCE_AND_GATES: Actual evidence sufficiency, proposition explanations and result/terminal gates use the complete applicable amended current input, response, availability, native, variance and receipt conjunction. No one minimum establishes success, no owner/name preserves obsolete semantics, and conditional reference gaps remain visible.
decisions.CURRENT_METRIC_AND_STABILITY: Metric implementation/display content depends on B due population, D normalized outcomes, E frozen normalized variance and applicable F1/F2 receipt/input evidence. Fixed ten-run arithmetic and denominator disclosure remain; old values and proofs are not inherited.
decisions.STRUCTURED_NEXT_ACTION_DERIVATION: The two proposed members concern structured output/UI wiring, not recalculating current action predicates. Their proposed changed classification is rejected by the specific corrections below; current ready/blocking derivations remain separately changed.
decisions.RETRY_AND_RESPONSE_CONTRACT: Actual validation failures and return/response contracts now include A/B/D/E current authored domains and F2 external admission. Retry context must describe those actual failures without invented observations; C1 leaves response transport unchanged.
decisions.CURRENT_TEST_BINDINGS: B canonical availability-proof relationships, D typed native definitions and E identical normalized variance forms govern current Stage06 binding validation. Initial nested proof authoring is distinct from accepted independent review or execution readiness; conditional XML details remain unresolved.
decisions.CURRENT_EXECUTION_EVENT_RECEIPTS: Actual native execution payloads and applicable F1 receipt content bind D outcomes, current definition/test/fixture/target/history, distinct actual pre/post inputs and F2 native observed custody. Atomic append, writers and reservation mechanisms remain; one receipt cannot invent two observations.
decisions.NATIVE_STAGE22_ACTION: Actual Stage22 native execution and its inclusion/readiness use B reviewed availability, D supported typed semantics and E current frozen test context. Application execution, one action and no unauthorized external fallback remain; applicable XML uncertainty cannot be called supported.
decisions.CONVERSATION_MODE: Source39.5 explicitly derives mode from human requests and validation; A changes those exact request/answer/blocking predicates. The current mode must reflect them while preserving conversation ownership, final response-file transport and original order.
decisions.CURRENT_PROPOSAL_VALUES_AND_PROVENANCE: Actual current proposal values and provenance must represent A typed requests/answers, B proof references, C/C1 source occurrences and E normalized variance. Old fields/lineage cannot stand in for this content. Mere exposure of the existing review command is separately retained.
decisions.ACCESSIBILITY_TRIGGER_DOMAIN: Focus/live-region destinations stay fixed, while A invalid-answer and A/B/D/E/F1/F2 readiness/blocker/result predicates change their current trigger domain. Current states must receive the original measurable behavior; uncertainty is not announced as favorable readiness.
decisions.COMPLETE_ACCEPTANCE_AND_SOURCE_COVERAGE: Complete current source/acceptance and final-publication evidence duties include the amended behavior and required positive/negative cases. Device/browser identities, actual deployed-byte verification, order and fail-closed publication stay required. This source obligation neither proves implementation nor prohibits running PR CI with honest pending work.
decisions.SECURITY_AND_STORAGE_FAILURE_DOMAIN: The complete negative security/storage cases now include C1 bounded isolated ZIP intake/reservation/resource blockers and D exact parsing/error outcomes. Original network/dynamic-code and mutation isolation remain; no intake limit is silently substituted for response transport or native-worker limits.
decisions.WORKER_TEST_DOMAIN: Full worker verification now covers D deterministic outputs, typed grammar and propagation in addition to the unchanged isolation/timeout/security properties. Neither the worker’s existence nor historical tests establish that complete current obligation.
decisions.DATE_ANSWER_SCHEMA: A closes the human DATE subset to Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD, years0001–9999 and no timezone conversion. Machine RFC3339 normalization and leap-second rejection retain separate meaning; the current schema duty includes both.
decisions.KNOWN_FIELD_AND_OPERATION_DOMAIN: A/B/D/E add exact closed field/argument domains, and F1 adds exactly38 conditional operation pairs. Unknown rejection uses those current domains; E nonoperative embedded context is no arbitrary-field permission and F1 is no unrestricted writer grant.
decisions.HASH_AND_NORMALIZER_DOMAIN: The registered hash/normalizer catalogue now includes A/B owning fields, C/C1 exact occurrence/profile preimages, D affected semantic identities and E entire normalized variance including nonoperative context. The canonical serializer, SHA, ID and Unicode algorithms remain unchanged.
decisions.ACTIVATION_PROOF: B closes current availability proof via accepted independent proof-expression review, actual observations, entailment, evidence, freshness and contradiction rules, with A/F2 relevant external admission. UNKNOWN is not FALSE and authoring is not accepted proof; branch sufficiency remains.
decisions.CURRENT_SCOPE_BINDING: Current context/scope binds applicable B/E proof/test/variance and F1 target/history/execution-test identities as well as original operation/reservation dimensions. F2 binds the same route inputs without added authority. Missing specialized binding details remain explicit.
decisions.CHECKPOINT_AND_DELIVERY_CURRENTNESS: Actual current delivery/checkpoint records depend on the complete amended upstream intake/review/test/variance/receipt/input closure. Exact delivery membership, destination authority, pre-delivery order and custody minima remain; an old checkpoint cannot certify current dependencies.
decisions.SPECIALIZED_PARSER_NECESSITY: The condition that a demonstrated test is unrepresentable by existing primitives must be evaluated against D’s current exact domain. C/C1 authorizes only its stated structural mappings. Determinism and no subject-domain architecture remain additional conjuncts; no parser is authorized by this review.
decisions.CORRECTION_6475: Base5075 requires making operationalNextAction() structured. Base4016–4027 fixes the structure; base5245 separately repeats this shape duty (the corresponding Phase2 atom6687 is proposed retained). A–F2 changes current ready/blocking values, not this output-structure predicate. Retain the structure duty; separately changed actual derivations still require current implementation/evidence.
decisions.CORRECTION_6532: Base5130 requires the primary UI to be driven by structured actions, matching base3995 engine-to-screen authority. It does not itself define a ready/blocking predicate. Amended current action values must still drive this unchanged UI linkage; the proposal conflates that architecture with changed action computation.
decisions.CORRECTION_6651: Base5214 requires exposing the named REVIEW_FILE_RESPONSE_PROPOSAL action alongside the other fixed file-first commands. Base4009 already lists that action. A/B/C/E changes proposal content or validation, not the existence/name/exposure of this control. Current proposal-value, review, provenance and readiness duties remain separately changed.
decisions.CORRECTION_6503: Base5105 requires response-ingestion to support /3, which means the current closed response contract, not merely an unchanged schema label. Base1295–1319 fixes that complete envelope and its registered operation/scope domains; base1324 binds the exact current response contract; base102 and940 reject schema-name equivalence as conformance. A/B/C/C1/D/E/F1/F2 alter current contained fields, registered semantics or admission/scope. Unlike the literal increment-to-/3 atoms6431/6432, this support obligation needs fresh effective context. All exact response transport, actor and partial-mutation constraints remain.
